name: ab_note_timing
description: A/B: bass note timing — c2 rest eb2 f2 at cps=0.5, verify notes hit expected slots
script: strudel ref note("c2 ~ eb2 f2").s("sawtooth").pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce REF: c2 ~ eb2 f2 (bass timing)
announce OURS: c2 ~ eb2 f2 (bass timing)
strudel edit note("c2 ~ eb2 f2").s("sawtooth").pianoroll() cps=0.5
check ab_harmonics ref.wav ours.wav extract:match_pct > 80 label:harmonics
